payload.unit_title: R21 Major Project Frontend Workspace Layout & UI Modernization (M2.2)
payload.objective: Evaluate unit M2.2 following M2.1 completion and issue the initial task dispatch (e.g. M2.2-ANALYZE-001 or M2.2-IMPLEMENT-001) with strict design-system and anti-duplication constraints.
payload.explicit_request: M2.1 is COMPLETED and checkpointed (commit da44888c). All dependencies for M2.2 are satisfied. Please evaluate M2.2 and issue the formal TASK_DISPATCH for M2.2. Every task must consider existing CampusLynk global shells (<x-layouts.workspace-layout>) and components (<x-ui.*>) to avoid duplication. Return decision: 'TASK_DISPATCH' with payload.task_dispatch.

payload.reason: M2.1 is completed and checkpointed at commit da44888c716a59a7e3f4381ce4297094d106ec40, satisfying the sole dependency gate for M2.2. Because M2.2 is a substantial UI modernization of a 2,611-line legacy workspace, the first autonomous action must be read-only architecture analysis rather than immediate implementation. The analysis must map the legacy workspace into modular sections, identify all backend endpoints and data dependencies exposed by M2.1, inspect the existing CampusLynk workspace shell and x-ui component inventory, identify reusable components versus genuine gaps, and produce a concrete implementation decomposition. No UI implementation should begin until that analysis is reviewed and explicitly approved by the architect.

task_dispatch.objective: Perform a read-only architectural analysis of the R21 Major Project frontend workspace migration and produce an implementation-ready decomposition that preserves CampusLynk's existing design system while replacing the legacy 2,611-line monolithic workspace.
instructions: Inspect the legacy R21 Major Project workspace view virtual_classroom_project.blade.php and all directly relevant legacy partials, scripts, styles, routes, and controller references needed to understand its complete behavior.

Inspect the completed CampusLynk M2.1 implementation, especially R21VirtualClassroomMajorProjectController.php, AttainmentService.php, the R21 Major Project models, and the registered routes, so the workspace analysis maps each UI action to the modern backend contract.
Inspect the existing CampusLynk resources/views/components/layouts/ workspace shells and resources/views/components/ui/ component inventory before proposing any new UI structure.

Map the legacy workspace into functional sections such as header/context, project/group management, syllabus/course-file handling, student/group evaluation, CIA/ESE evaluation, attainment summary, examiner management, autosave/bulk actions, alerts, loading/error states, and navigation/actions. Only include sections actually supported by the inspected source.

Identify every legacy UI element that can be replaced by an existing x-ui.* component. Explicitly distinguish reusable existing components from genuine component gaps; do not propose duplicate components merely because the legacy UI uses different markup.
Design the target workspace around x-layouts.workspace-layout. Do not propose a parallel page shell or custom workspace framework.
Decompose the 2,611-line legacy view into modular Blade partials/components, with no target Blade view exceeding 500 lines without a documented architectural reason.
Map required modals, tables, buttons, badges, tabs, alerts, inputs, selects, icons, and progress indicators to the existing x-ui.* components. Do not invent raw equivalents.

Inspect all AJAX/fetch/form endpoints used by the legacy workspace and reconcile them against the 11 M2.1 routes. Flag any endpoint or behavior that is not covered by the completed backend rather than silently inventing a replacement.
Identify JavaScript behavior that must be preserved, rewritten, or simplified for the modern workspace. Preserve functional behavior while removing legacy duplication and monolithic coupling.

Identify any dependencies or hidden coupling with AttendanceController, shared controllers, or other migration units. Do not expand M2.2 scope into unrelated units; report such coupling as a dependency/risk.

Produce a concrete implementation plan split into small independently verifiable slices. Each proposed slice must have a clear file whitelist, objective, acceptance criteria, and verification strategy.
Do NOT modify application code, Blade views, JavaScript, CSS, routes, models, migrations, database state, STATE.json, or FEATURE_MATRIX.md.
Do NOT create commits or alter repository state.
Return a TASK_REPORT only after completing the read-only analysis.
constraints: READ-ONLY analysis only; no repository implementation changes.
Do not modify STATE.json or FEATURE_MATRIX.md.
Do not modify application files, routes, migrations, models, database schema, or tests.
Do not create duplicate layout or UI components when an existing x-layouts.* or x-ui.* component is suitable.
The target workspace must use x-layouts.workspace-layout.
Do not copy the legacy 2,611-line view into CampusLynk as a monolith.
No raw table markup, ad-hoc button styling, custom modal implementation, or duplicate SVG/icon system where an existing x-ui.* component applies.
Do not expand into M2.3 print-report implementation.
Do not implement unresolved cross-unit dependencies; report them as risks or blockers for architect review.
Legacy repository remains read-only reference material.
task_dispatch.expected_report: A TASK_REPORT containing: legacy workspace files inspected; complete functional-section inventory; legacy endpoint/AJAX mapping; mapping of each relevant UI element to existing CampusLynk x-ui.* components; workspace-layout integration findings; proposed modular Blade/partial/component structure; JavaScript behavior migration plan; M2.1 backend-to-UI mapping; hidden dependencies or risks; files proposed for each implementation slice; acceptance criteria and verification commands for each slice; unresolved ambiguities; and a recommended first implementation slice for architect approval.
stop_conditions: Stop immediately if implementation changes would be required to continue the analysis; report the blocker instead.
Do not modify any repository or database state.
Do not create or modify migration control-plane state.
Stop after producing the complete TASK_REPORT.
